content.short: Three Sigma is a leading European consulting firm offering code audits, economic audits, and blockchain design and development.
content.description: Three Sigma is a leading blockchain auditing firm dedicated to Web3 security, offering expert auditing services and a meticulous, rigorous approach designed to keep projects secure, dependable, and ready to scale confidently. In addition to smart contract auditing and development work, the firm delivers support for economic modeling in tokenomics, mechanism design, and agent-based simulations through its proprietary framework.
